attchmntText: Pioneer Embroideries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'OUTCOME OF THE BOARD MEETING HELD ON 11TH NOVEMBER, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Pioneer Embroideries Limited reported a net loss of 184.96 lakh for the half year ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 270.73 lakh in the previous year. Net sales for the period stood at 19,992.66 lakh. The Board approved the sale of the Sarigam Embroidery Unit land and building to M/s. Alchemy Interchem Private Limited for Rs. 1.89 crores, with proceeds designated for working capital. The company also reported a net cash inflow from operating activities of 578.25 lakh for the half year. Financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board on 11th November 2026.

attchmntText: Pioneer Embroideries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Pioneer Embroideries Limited reported a net loss of 184.96 lakh for the half year ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 270.73 lakh in the same period last year. Net sales for the half year were 19,992.66 lakh. The Board approved the sale of the Sarigam Embroidery Unit land and building to M/s. Alchemy Interchem Private Limited for Rs. 1.89 crores, with proceeds to be used for working capital. The company also reported a net loss of 190.59 lakh on a consolidated basis for the half year. Earnings per share for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 were negative 0.64. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board on 11th November 2026.
